items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
items.summary: Thailand's SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget's operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.

items.title: Morning Minute: Democrat Sweep Pumps Crypto as Clarity Act Resurfaces
items.summary: The Dems are already talking compromise on the Clarity Act and their requests all seem logical - does the bill have new life?

items.title: Binance Cuts Off SignalPlus API Keys Over 'Potential Security Issue' at Trading Platform
items.summary: The exchange said its own systems and user funds are unaffected, a week after it lost $6.4 billion in a hack blamed on North Korea.

items.title: Anchorage Digital seeks CFTC swap dealer registration for crypto options business
items.summary: Anchorage Digital has applied for CFTC swap dealer registration and plans to offer European-style bitcoin and ether options if approved.

items.title: Treasury's cash plan points to a possible December liquidity window for Bitcoin
items.summary: Treasury's November 4 plan frames a possible December respite, while tax receipts and a projected January cash peak complicate the reserve case.

items.title: Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance's
items.summary: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.
